# Misère Perdue (Misery)

> Misère Perdue (Misery) - Merchandise brand and creative community based in Toronto.

Misère Perdue is a merchandise brand and creative community based in Toronto, Canada. The official site is https://misereperdue.com/. The brand's first capsule releases Spring 2027. The site includes a shop, a community chat, and a forum.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://misereperdue.com/): Misère Perdue — merchandise brand and creative community based in Toronto.
- [Shop](https://misereperdue.com/shop.html): Misère Perdue merchandise.
- [Forum](https://misereperdue.com/#globe): Community forum.

## Brand facts

- Name: Misère Perdue (also known as MISERY, misereperdue)
- Type: Merchandise brand and creative community
- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Official site: https://misereperdue.com/
- Social: https://x.com/misereperdue
